name: Academic article
description: A conventional evidence-led article structure with reusable academic writing decisions.

brief.description: A focused academic article that develops and supports one central contribution.
brief.targetAudience: Scholarly readers in the relevant field
brief.citationRequirements: Support substantive claims with traceable sources.
brief.additionalInstructions: State the contribution clearly and distinguish evidence from interpretation.

outline.title: Introduction
outline.objective: Frame the problem, gap, contribution, and roadmap.

outline.title: Background
outline.objective: Establish the relevant literature and conceptual context.

outline.title: Methods
outline.objective: Explain the evidence and analytical method reproducibly.

outline.title: Conclusion
outline.objective: Synthesize the contribution and next steps.

writingRules.instruction: Do not present an unsupported inference as an established fact.
writingRules.rationale: Keep claims calibrated to the available evidence.

writingRules.instruction: State limitations explicitly where they affect interpretation.

name: 中文研究报告
description: 适用于中文研究与分析报告的简洁结构。

brief.description: 围绕明确问题形成可核验、可执行的研究报告。
brief.targetAudience: 需要基于证据做出决策的读者
brief.citationRequirements: 关键事实和判断应标明可追溯来源。
brief.additionalInstructions: 先给结论，再说明证据、限制和建议。

outline.title: 问题与范围
outline.objective: 界定研究问题、范围和限制。

outline.title: 证据与分析
outline.objective: 呈现可核验的证据与分析。

outline.title: 建议
outline.objective: 给出有优先级和边界条件的建议。

writingRules.instruction: 避免空泛的程度副词，优先使用可核验的具体表述。
